basic_identification.full_title: Dimensions for Ceramic Bushings for Terminals (टर्मिनलों के लिए सिरेमिक बुशिंग के आयाम)
basic_identification.sector_category: Electrotechnical / Electrical Insulators and Accessories (finalized by the Electrical Insulators and Accessories Sectional Committee, ETD 06 / ETD 11, of the Bureau of Indian Standards)

sectional_committee.name: Electrical Insulators and Accessories Sectional Committee

scope.summary: This Indian Standard prescribes the standardized physical dimensions, tolerances, shapes, and general requirements for ceramic (porcelain or steatite) bushings (tubes) used as terminal insulators. These bushings prevent flashovers and ground faults where current-carrying conductors pass through the earthed metal casings or enclosures of rotating electrical machines, capacitors, transformers, and other electrical apparatus.

certification_and_marking.standard_type: Product Dimensional Specification (Electrotechnical Department / Electrical Insulators)
certification_and_marking.certification_status: Voluntary Product Specification. Manufacturers are highly encouraged to apply for a BIS license to print the physical ISI 'Standard Mark' directly on the packaging of ceramic bushings or the component itself to certify dimensional and material conformity.

requirements.detail: Observed or calculated final test values, observed dimensions, or physical properties must be rounded off mathematically in accordance with IS 2:1960. The number of significant places retained should match that of the specified value in the standard.
Bushings must be manufactured from high-grade ceramic insulating materials (porcelain, steatite, or alumina) conforming to the physical and chemical requirements of IS 8765 : 1978.

The exposed surfaces of the ceramic bushing must be smoothly and uniformly glazed (typically in standard dark brown or white/off-white finishes) to prevent moisture absorption, resist chemical attack, and minimize creepage tracking.
Permissible limits of visual surface defects (cracks, structural chips, or pinholes) must comply with IS 13305 : 1992 to guarantee structural and dielectric integrity.

Standardizes inside diameter (d1), outside diameter (d2), total length (L), and collar thickness (t) of the bushing. Tolerances are calibrated based on the kiln shrinking characteristic of clay/ceramics during firing.
Standardizes the collar design and groove depth for optional sealing gaskets or O-rings used to prevent water ingress into the rotating electrical machine or capacitor terminal.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 10314 : 1982 (Reaffirmed 2021) is the primary national Indian Standard specification prescribing standardized dimensions and tolerances for ceramic bushings (tubes) used as terminal insulators. Developed under the Electrical Insulators and Accessories Sectional Committee (ETD 11), the standard unifies dimensional ranges for terminals of rotating electrical machines, capacitors, and electrical apparatus where current-carrying conductors pass through earthed metal casings. It mandates high-grade glazed finishes (conforming to IS 8765 material specifications) to prevent moisture ingress, limits visual defects to protect dielectric strength, and coordinates with motor insulation (IS 10026) and safety auditing standards (IS 14489).
